title: शुक्रवार

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, stands at the counter of a small Indian general store stacked with Diwali goods, string lights above, she turns to the camera and smiles warmly.
scenes.vo: नमस्ते, मैं लूमी हूँ। यह मीना की कहानी है। दिवाली का माल आ गया था, बिक्री भी अच्छी थी।
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Meena's story. The Diwali stock had come, and sales were good too.
scenes.title: शुक्रवार

scenes.clip: A woman shopkeeper in a cotton saree at the counter of a small Indian store, a supplier in a checked shirt across the counter tapping a bill, Diwali stock piled behind, tense afternoon light.
scenes.vo: फिर भी शुक्रवार को सप्लायर को देने के लिए पैसा नहीं था।
scenes.sub: And still, on Friday, there was nothing to pay the supplier with.

scenes.clip: Close on a woman's hands photographing a handwritten ledger with a phone at a shop counter, Diwali lights in the background, warm evening.
scenes.vo: उसने बस अपनी बही की फोटो खींची। मुनाफ़ा था, नकद नहीं था। पैसा ग्राहकों के पास अटका था।
scenes.sub: She just took a photo of her notebook. The profit was there, the cash was not. It was stuck with customers.

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, stands beside the shop counter looking at a phone and nodding, the woman shopkeeper beside him relieved, warm shop light.
scenes.vo: तीन ग्राहकों को एक एक टैप में याद दिलाया। शाम तक दो ने भुगतान कर दिया।
scenes.sub: Three customers reminded, one tap each. By evening, two had paid.

scenes.clip: A supplier counting notes with a smile at a small Indian shop counter on a Friday afternoon, the woman shopkeeper handing them over, Diwali lanterns above.
scenes.vo: शुक्रवार को सप्लायर को पूरा पैसा मिला। और उसका स्कोर ऊपर गया।
scenes.sub: On Friday the supplier was paid in full. And her score went up.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। अपने धंधे की सेहत जानिए। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।

caption: Meena's shop sold well. On Friday there was still nothing to pay the supplier with. Lumi tells what happened next.
linkedin_text:
Meena's saree shop in Jaipur sold well through Diwali. On Friday there was still nothing to pay the supplier with.

This is the gap most small-business owners live in: profit on paper, cash with customers. Lumi, our new guide, tells Meena's week in Hindi with English subtitles. Everything on screen is the real ScoreMyBiz app.
